Phil Medina Live

9:00 PM · The Stand Up Comedy Club · $18.79

BUY YOUR TICKETS HERE SO YOU ARE FOR SURE COMING IN FOR A NIGHT OF LAUGHTER AND TO WIN SOME PRIZES TOO!! The Madera-born comic has gone from cracking up classmates to headlining clubs nationwide, including the Laugh Factory, Hollywood Improv and Ice House. He's performed at Netflix Is A Joke Festival, appeared on Hulu, entertained U.S. troops around the world---and, because apparently stand-up wasn't enough, he's also the national voice of Hungry Howie's Pizza. Phil Medina Live Always brings the house down!!! he also brings his high-energy storytelling, razor-sharp crowd work and dangerously contagious charisma to the stage for one seriously funny night. Grab your tickets now before the only thing left to laugh at is yourself for waiting. ****************************************** SCAM ALERT---IMPORTANT TICKET INFORMATION ****************************************** To protect our customers, please DO NOT purchase tickets from third-party sites such as StubHub, VividSeats, BoxOfficeTicketSales, EventTicketCenter, eTickets, Ticket-Center, TicketSales, or any other unauthorized platforms. If you have any questions, please call us directly at 562-202-9944. Our ONLY authorized ticketing partner is TicketWeb, which is linked directly from our website: TheStandUpClub.com. Ticket resale is strictly prohibited. Tickets suspected of being purchased for the sole purpose of resale may be canceled at the discretion of The Stand Up Club.
